department_description:
HKT Enterprise Solutions is provided by HKT Commercial Group. It delivers end-to-end integrated solutions employing emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things, cloud computing, and data analytics to assist enterprises in transforming their businesses.
Powered by HKT’s best-in-class fixed and mobile networks, HKT Enterprise Solutions enables companies to enhance operational efficiency and gain business insights.
HKT Commercial Group has a strong track record for Information and Communications Technologies (ICT) innovations serving the needs of commercial and wholesale organizations of different sizes and industries in Hong Kong, Mainland China and beyond.
Our pioneering approach in providing “Next Generation ICT Solutions and Services” includes world-class carrier-grade cloud platforms, ultra high-speed fixed and mobile networks, award-winning industry-specific SME solutions, fixed-mobile integration, advanced cross-border capabilities and end-to-end systems integration in addressing customer needs to fuel their business growth.
We have a strong team of more than 8,000+ professionals in Hong Kong, Macau and China regions, contributing to various business functions including commercial sales and marketing, solutions consulting, product development & management, China commercial business, and contact center outsourcing services, etc.

department_description:
Engineering is responsible for the planning, building and operation of the HKT’s local fixed and wireless network to support the Group’s quadruple play business (Fixed, Broadband, Wireless and IPTV). Engineering works closely with the CTO office in monitoring technological development and determining the technology roadmap for HKT’s network evolution. It also supports various BUs to turn product ideas into marketable services.

Engineering also serves as HKT’s delivery arm of engineering services and provides outsourced operation and management services to our enterprise / corporate customers. In addition to local business, Engineering also supports the Group’s international businesses in overseas markets.

department_description:
Our team runs The Club, one of Hong Kong’s most prominent customer-loyalty programs, offering privileges and offers.
We help retain customers by providing the membership with a succession of memorable experiences such as priority booking when purchasing tickets for high-profile entertainment and sporting events.
In addition, we source a variety of attractive rewards, such as today’s hottest electronic gadgets and air tickets, plus exclusive privileges – all of which our members can enjoy simply by redeeming their Clubpoints.
Our customers are invited to become members of The Club and earn Clubpoints by subscribing to various HKT services and making purchases from The Club’s partner merchants. This creates a win-win-win ecosystem that benefits members, HKT and our various partner organizations.
